text.caption_colours: Yellow or red text with black/white outlines, or white text inside solid black rounded cards
text.active_word: None; titles and key stat callouts appear as static text blocks with pop animation
text.title_entry: Instant scale pop with slight bounce
text.number_entry: Pop-in with bold colored typography accompanied by graphic images
